newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-TAYLOR WINS TOSS, PUTS ENGLAND INTO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TAYLOR WINS TOSS, PUTS ENGLAND INTO BAT.

text.p: Australian captain Mark Taylor won the toss and put England into bat on the second day of the second test against England at Lord's on Friday.
Rain washed out Thursday's opening day without a ball being bowled.
The weather was cool and cloudy and the pitch soft with further rain forecast for later in the day.
England retained the team who won the first test in the six-test Ashes series by nine wickets while Paul Reiffel replaced injured fast bowler Jason Gillespie in the Australian side.
Michael Atherton was captaining England for the 42nd time, breaking the previous national record set by the late Peter May.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andrew Caddick, Devon Malcolm.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Michael Kasprowicz, Glenn McGrath.
